# Align PR template with skill anchors and cross-lab LLM disclosure

## Context

Operator-directed (`2026-11-15`) Phase-1 alignment in `neomjs/neo` (`Engine` first; sibling rollouts in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`, `neomjs/neo-agent-skills`, and `neomjs/neo-agent-institution` wait until a cross-family peer approves the `Engine` PR).

Currently every external pull request arriving in this repository is AI-assisted or AI-generated. Contributors opening a PR through the GitHub UI are pre-filled with the legacy checkbox form in `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` (`Bugfix`, `Feature`, `Does this PR introduce a breaking change?`, `**Other information:**`), which shares none of the canonical headings or anchors enforced by `.agents/skills/pull-request/references/pull-request-workflow.md` (`§9.1`). As a result, external PRs either combine both incompatible templates or drop required sections, while also omitting the model, version, and reasoning effort needed to route cross-rival-lab reviews.

## The Problem

- **Template split:** `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` still reflects the pre-agent checkbox form rather than the canonical `pull-request` skill body (`Resolves #N`, concise outcome paragraph, `Evidence:`, `## AC Evidence`, `## Deltas from ticket`, `## Test Evidence`, `## Post-Merge Validation`, `Authored by `). Meanwhile `neomjs/neo-agent-skills`'s `check-pr-body.mjs` validates those exact anchors on every `ai`-labeled PR, and `pull-request/SKILL.md` states both external contributors and maintainers share that canonical body and factual attribution.
- **Missing cross-lab LLM disclosure & rationale:** Neither `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` nor `CONTRIBUTING.md` instructs contributors to state the **model, exact version, reasoning effort, and agent/harness** together with the reason why: **enabling cross-rival-lab review routing** (a PR naming a model lab is reviewed by a maintainer running a rival lab's model).
- **Parser traps if phrased carelessly:** `ai/services/graph/disclosedModelFamilies.mjs` (`neomjs/neo-agent-brain`) scans raw body lines (including HTML comments) for real vendor/model keywords and strips dotted-version slash tokens like `Model-1.0/high` as path places (`MODEL_ID` allows only `[a-z\d][\w-]*` without dots before `/`, so `isPlace()` drops the token unless a vendor-named harness repeats the family word). Any unfilled template containing example vendor names in comments would misclassify every external PR.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: "Both audiences use the canonical body and factual attribution; private identity, routing and lifecycle requirements apply to maintainers only." (`.agents/skills/pull-request/SKILL.md`), together with operator direction (`2026-11-15`) requiring model, version, and reasoning effort disclosure for cross-rival-lab reviews and `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml` / `neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-pr-body.mjs` (`VISIBLE_PR_BODY_ANCHORS`, `INVISIBLE_PR_BODY_ANCHORS`).

Prescription checked: `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` — owns the GitHub PR pre-fill template; `CONTRIBUTING.md` — owns public contributor PR & AI transparency instructions.

- `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md:1-45` holds the legacy checkbox template ending with `**Other information:**`.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md:147-159` (§3 item 4) and `CONTRIBUTING.md:172-183` (§5 Transparency & Autonomous Agents) reference `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` and currently say "briefly mention which model or agent framework was used" without specifying model + version + reasoning effort or cross-rival-lab review routing.
- `check-pr-body.mjs` requires line-opening headings `## AC Evidence`, `## Test Evidence`, `## Post-Merge Validation`, `## Deltas`, plus substring anchors `Evidence:` and `Authored by `, and a single standalone `Resolves #N` line. Using `Authored by @<github-handle> (...)` satisfies both `check-pr-body.mjs` and `disclosedModelFamilies.mjs`'s `DISCLOSURE` regex on one line.
- Overlapping open unassigned tickets `#20895` (standing rungs, badge docs, claim-responder update, plus an `AC-4` proposal to add `**AI disclosure:**` under `**Other information:**`) and `#21025` (optional contributor assistance checkbox/guidance) touch `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` for orthogonal concerns and are coordinated at creation without absorbing their separate scopes.

## The Fix

### Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` | `pull-request/SKILL.md`, `check-pr-body.mjs`, operator `2026-11-15` cross-lab ruling | Pre-fills the unified `§9.1` structure (`Resolves #`, outcome + public-behavior prompt, linked `Evidence Ladder` L1–L4 comment + `Evidence:`, `## AC Evidence`, `## Deltas from ticket`, `## Test Evidence`, `## Post-Merge Validation` with angle-bracket placeholders instead of pre-filled assertions, `Authored by `) prompting for `@<github-handle>`, model, version, reasoning effort (`default` fallback when hidden), and agent/harness, plus HTML comments stating cross-rival-lab review routing. Zero vendor/model keywords appear in comments. | Contributors not using an LLM write `(no LLM)` on `Authored by `; contributors whose tool exposes no effort knob write `reasoning: default`; `disclosedFamiliesOf()` returns `[]` so any maintainer may review. | Self-documented via HTML comments + `CONTRIBUTING.md` | Verified locally with `npx neo-agent-skills-pr-body` and `disclosedFamiliesOf()` unit/node probes (`[]` unfilled, exact family extraction when filled). |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` (§3 item 4, §5 Human Operators item 1, §5 Autonomous Agents item 1) | Operator `2026-11-15` ruling + `pull-request-workflow.md §9.1` | Aligns §3 item 4 with the unified template and `npx neo-agent-skills-pr-body`; updates §5 Transparency and Autonomous Agents guidance to ask for model, exact version, reasoning effort (`reasoning: default` when unexposed), and agent/harness on `Authored by ` to enable cross-rival-lab review routing. | Existing `--close-target-only` remains available for non-`ai` human PRs where anchor checks do not gate merge. | `CONTRIBUTING.md` itself | `npm run check-relative-links` and `npx neo-agent-skills-guides --skip dead-script-ref` pass. |

Decision Record impact: none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` carries every `check-pr-body.mjs` canonical section and anchor (`Resolves #`, outcome/behavior-change summary prompt, Evidence Ladder L1–L4 link comment + `Evidence:`, `## AC Evidence`, `## Deltas from ticket`, `## Test Evidence`, `## Post-Merge Validation`, `Authored by `) with placeholder text for unfilled sections (no pre-filled assertions), replacing the legacy checkbox template, and passes `npx neo-agent-skills-pr-body --body-file <file>` once a single ticket number is filled after `Resolves #`.
- [ ] AC-2: `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` explicitly asks LLM-assisted/authored PRs to specify **model, version, reasoning effort (`reasoning: default` fallback when hidden), and agent/harness** on the `Authored by ` line (comma-separated, or `(no LLM)` when unwritten by an LLM) and states the **cross-rival-lab review** rationale.
- [ ] AC-3: Running `disclosedFamiliesOf({body})` (`ai/services/graph/disclosedModelFamilies.mjs`) on the raw unfilled `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` returns `[]` (no vendor/model keywords leaked into hints/comments), while filling `<model + version>, reasoning: <effort or default>, <agent or harness>` cleanly extracts the expected family key.
- [ ] AC-4: `CONTRIBUTING.md` (§3 item 4 and §5 Human Operators / Autonomous Agents) matches `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`, asks for model, exact version, reasoning effort, and agent/harness, and explains the cross-rival-lab review rationale.
- [ ] AC-5: `npm run check-relative-links` and `npx neo-agent-skills-guides --skip dead-script-ref` pass with zero hard errors.

## Out of Scope

- Opening matching PR-template alignment PRs in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`, `neomjs/neo-agent-skills`, or `neomjs/neo-agent-institution` — deferred to Phase 2 (tracked via `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#406`) after a cross-family peer approves this `neomjs/neo` PR, per operator instruction (`2026-11-15`).
- Delivering `#20895`'s "Your standing" rungs, badge formats, or claim-responder guide prose (coordinated so `#20895` drops its superseded `**Other information:**` template bullet).
- Delivering `#21025`'s contributor-assistance policy prose and optional help-request invitation checkbox (coordinated so `#21025` anchors onto the updated `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`).
- Modifying `check-pr-body.mjs` or `disclosedModelFamilies.mjs` enforcement logic itself.

## Avoided Traps

- **Naming any vendor or model inside `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` comments:** `disclosedFamiliesOf()` does not strip HTML comments, so any real model name inside hint text would cause every unfilled PR to falsely disclose that model family and block rival-lab reviewers. Neutral placeholders only (`<model + version>`, `reasoning: <effort>`).
- **Joining dotted versions and effort with `/` (e.g. `Model-1.0/high` under a vendor-neutral harness):** `disclosedModelFamilies.mjs`'s `MODEL_ID` allows `[a-z\d][\w-]*` (no dots) before `/`, so `isPlace()` strips dotted-version slash tokens to `[]` whenever the harness name does not independently repeat the vendor word. Comma separation (`model + version, reasoning: effort, harness`) avoids that trap across every harness.
- **Unindented closing-keyword examples in HTML comments:** `check-pr-body.mjs` scans HTML comments outside 4-space/fenced code blocks for `GITHUB_CLOSING_EXPRESSION`, so keyword warnings in comments must keep `#<issue-id>` rather than concrete numeric examples.
- **Applying `good first issue` / `help wanted`:** Omitted because this is operator-directed Phase-1 rollout immediately self-assigned by `@neo-gemini-maryam`.
